composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-115a, "BLACK WATER SYSTEM") serves two related but distinct groups on the Gelliceaux: (1) the four WC/toilet flush-water pump circuits (Port Aft Guest, Stbd Aft Guest, Port Crew Head/Fwd Crew Heads, Stbd Crew Head/Aft Crew Heads) driven from DC Main Panel breakers Q7-Q10 via relays Re15-Re18 into controller/junction modules with water shut-off valves and pumps — these map to 540-wc-toilets (the WC fixtures) with their supply pumps under 540-black-water-pumps per the engineer mapping; and (2) the FWD and AFT black water tank pump-out systems (Q11 32A / Q12 32A) with senders, timers T1/T2, relay/switch S01/S02, and PC-card tank-level sensing (A/F/E taps) feeding FWD/AFT BLACK WATER PUMPs — these map directly to 540-black-water-pumps. The T/S B terminal strip block (19-30: DWG115 refs, LOW BAT ALARM, MASTERVOLT EASY VIEW, SHORE POWER PANEL, GENERAL COCKPIT ALARM, PEDESTAL LTS) is shared monitoring/status infrastructure that belongs to the main panel/distribution node (641-vessel-control-panel), not to the black water system itself — it is only routed through this sheet's terminal strip.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: 540-wc-toilets (Port Aft Guest WC, Stbd Aft Guest WC, Port Crew Head WC, Stbd Crew Head WC)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Load names Q7-Q10 explicitly name PORT AFT GUEST WC, STBD AFT GUEST WC, PORT CREW HEAD WC, STBD CREW HEAD WC — matching the engineer-confirmed mapping to 540-wc-toilets. Each breaker feeds a relay (NC contact) into T/S C terminal (106-109) then to a controller module with BR/BL/GRY wiring driving a WATER SHUT-OFF valve and a flush pump, ending at the named heads (PORT AFT GUEST HEADS, STBD AFT GUEST HEADS, FWD CREW HEADS, AFT CREW HEADS).

infrastructure.system_name: T/S B terminal strip status/monitoring rail (owned by 641-vessel-control-panel)
facts: T/S B terminals 19/20 both annotated 'DWG115' — cross-drawing wired reference, resolved on that other sheet, not detailed here.
T/S B terminal 21 ties to Re19 coil return; terminal 22 destination unresolved on this sheet (multiple unresolved refs).
T/S B terminal 23 has no printed load label (spare/unlabelled way).

T/S B terminal 24 = LOW BAT. ALARM, 25 = MASTERVOLT EASY VIEW, 26 = SHORE POWER PANEL, 27 = GENERAL COCKPIT ALARM, 28 = PEDESTAL LTS (COMPASS LTS) — these are status/monitoring taps off the main panel terminal strip, not part of the black water system; they physically sit on the same terminal block but are a different, unrelated set of circuits per the sheet's own layout.

Re19 relay coil is fed on the + side from T/S B terminal 20 via a switch (cross-ref to DWG115); the - side returns via T/S B terminal 21 and ties into the common vertical return line shared with Re15-Re18 diode returns — function of Re19 itself (what it switches) is not labelled on this sheet.
